items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: another guy that I had experience with that you might like to hear was Willard Robeson

ctx.x: It wasn't anything that I should -- I'm very happy to mention it because it happened. But now, to get to another guy that I had experience with that you might like to hear was Willard Robeson. Did you ever hear of Willard?
Well, I know about him, you know, something about him. I know some of this music.
